title: Past Perfect
intro:
Past perfect: had + past participle, untuk semua subjek. Dipakai untuk kejadian yang terjadi lebih dulu daripada kejadian lampau lainnya.
She had eaten before I arrived.
They had left when we came.

exercises.question: She ___ before I arrived.
exercises.explanation: Past perfect memakai had + past participle. Bentuk ketiga dari eat adalah eaten.

exercises.question: They ___ home when it started to rain.
exercises.explanation: Had + past participle. Bentuk ketiga dari go adalah gone, bukan went.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the past perfect
exercises.explanation: Had + past participle. 'Finish' beraturan, jadi finished.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the past perfect
exercises.sentence: He ___ (write) the letter before she called.
exercises.explanation: Bentuk ketiga dari write adalah written: had written.

exercises.prompt: Match each verb to its past participle
exercises.explanation: Past participle dipakai setelah had: take jadi taken, give jadi given, know jadi known, speak jadi spoken.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order
exercises.answer: We had already left the house
exercises.explanation: Subjek + had + already + past participle. Kata already diletakkan di antara had dan kata kerja.

exercises.question: Pick the correct past perfect sentence.
options: She has had seen that film.
exercises.explanation: Had + past participle. Bentuk ketiga dari see adalah seen, bukan saw.
Past simple jadi past perfect: had + past participle.

exercises.task: Write one sentence about something you had done before you came home.
exercises.modelAnswer: I had eaten lunch before I came home.
exercises.explanation: Gunakan had + past participle, misalnya 'I had eaten lunch before I came home.'
